summary: canonical_candidate_diff_sha256 crashes with CalledProcessError (git exit 129) on git 2.43.0 whenever a baseline range is diffed, so the digest tests and gate cannot run on that git.
failure_scenario: Linux host with git 2.43.0 (Ubuntu 24.04 default) -> `git diff ... -O /dev/null <base>..<head>` in scripts/release_gate.py (~line 272) prints 'Not a git repository ... --no-index' usage and exits 129; the gate raises instead of producing a digest, and test_release_digest_ignores_ambient_config/interhunk/order_file fail. No git-version precondition is asserted or documented by the tests.
evidence: Called gate.canonical_candidate_diff_sha256 on a scratch repo with git 2.43.0: CalledProcessError 129. Same flags with `-O /dev/null HEAD~1 HEAD` (two args) succeed, and `-O/dev/null HEAD~1..HEAD` also succeeds, so the failure is the separated '-O /dev/null' plus '..' range form. Did not confirm which CI git version is used; repo pytest env could not be installed offline so the suite itself was not run.
